# Seeking Refuge in God's Presence

## Scripture

"A Prayer of David." The Lord is my rock, my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid? - Psalm 27:1 (NIV)

## Reflection

As we navigate life's challenges, it's easy to become overwhelmed and lose focus. In times of turmoil, we can either turn to the world for answers or to God for refuge. Psalm 27 reminds us that our strength lies in God's presence. We are not alone in our struggles, and our fears are diminished when we remember that God is our rock, our salvation, and our stronghold. We can't put our trust in anything or anyone else, for they will inevitably fail. But God remains faithful and unwavering. Let us turn to Him in times of need, seeking His guidance and protection. By doing so, we will find peace and clarity in the midst of uncertainty.

## Prayer

We come before You, God, seeking refuge in Your presence. You are our rock, our salvation, and our stronghold. We trust in Your unwavering faithfulness and ask for Your guidance and protection.

## One-Line Application

We can face life's challenges with confidence, knowing God is our rock, our salvation, and our stronghold.
